result.summary: Found 2 issues: one major layout/loading issue and one minor content truncation issue.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' section shows a loading spinner overlaid on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image, indicating the image has not fully loaded or is stuck in a loading state.
issues.suggestion: Ensure images are fully loaded before displaying, or implement a proper skeleton/placeholder state that transitions cleanly once the image is ready. Investigate any network or lazy-loading issues causing the spinner to remain visible.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel appears to be truncated mid-word (likely 'Trattoria Piccolo' or similar), cutting off the name abruptly below the card.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis (e.g., CSS 'text-overflow: ellipsis') or allow the card enough width to display the full name, rather than cutting mid-word.
